the optimal bandwidth allocation policy is the one that allocates the largest bandwidth to the strongest signal, while the optimal power allocation policy is the uniform one.

bandwidth allocation is a very important issue for localization in MIMO radar.
bandwidth is a much better resource to be used than power in MIMO radars for target localization.
